summary: VOX Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing its subsidiary Vox Cayman agreed to sell its capped gold offtake stream (i-80 Stream) to i-80 Gold Corp. for $4.8 million, satisfied through issuance of freely tradeable i-80 common shares. The stream covered 100% of gold production from Ruby Hill, Cove & Granite Creek up to 40k oz/yr through Dec 2028; Vox acquired it Sep 2025 in a portfolio purchase. Vox's carrying value was ~$2.6M, implying ~2x multiple. Closing expected by June 30, 2026. Watch for timely share issuance and Vox's redeployment of capital into uncapped assets.
